Enamel kettle, two litres

This kettle is pressed from one sheet of steel and coated inside and out in a hard glass enamel that will not taint water. It holds two litres, sits steady on a gas ring or a wood stove, and has a folding wire handle that stays cool enough to lift. The lid is held by a short chain so it cannot be lost on a camp, and the spout pours cleanly without dripping down the side. Each one is finished by hand, so the colour can vary a little from one kettle to the next.
